LAYOUT SAMPLE · NOT A PUBLISHED ARTICLE

A place for a longer thought

A sample of how an article will read on this site.

This page demonstrates the layout. It is not an article written by Erick.

Start with the idea

The opening introduces a question, an experience, or something worth exploring. A short introduction helps readers decide whether they want to keep reading.

Give it room

The main sections can hold an explanation, examples from a project, a reflection on a book, or a change in perspective. Each section has enough space to make one point clearly.

A short quotation or central idea can stand apart from the rest of the text.

Leave something to think about

The ending can return to the original question, share a lesson, or leave an open question for another day.
